text:
maria: Quick brain dump  were proposing a left-rail regroup: Top clusters -> Projects (or Apps), Models, Platform. Aim: flatten paths, make deep links resilient, and improve scan/spot for new users. Reaction?
eli: Projects makes sense to non-ML folks. My only UX worry: deep links today highlight the first matching nav item; if we flatten, ensure leaf matching takes precedence. Example: /ws/42/models/abc/metrics should light Models > abc, not Projects.
samir: Accessibility check: collapse controls must be real buttons with aria-expanded and aria-controls. When expanded via keyboard, focus should move predictably. Also breadcrumbs need aria-label="Breadcrumb" and the current page should have aria-current="page".
aisha: Copy bikeshed: "Projects" vs "Apps" vs "Workloads". I prefer "Projects" because its product-friendly. Also propose microcopy under cluster: "Open resource in workspace" for deep-link fallbacks.
tess: Routing edge-case: if a deep link contains an asset id from another workspace, do we 1) try to resolve equivalent id in current workspace, 2) redirect to cluster hub with inline notice, or 3) show modal asking to switch workspace? I vote for #2 (less disruptive).
maria: Agreed on fallback to hub with a non-blocking notice. UX: show a small banner near breadcrumbs: "The linked resource isnt in this workspace. Showing Models hub instead." with an action: "Try original workspace" (if user can switch).
eli: Dev note: I'll implement matching precedence: exact leaf -> section -> cluster. Also add a unit test for route highlight priority and a small integration test for workspace-switch fallback.
samir: + Accessibility add: add a visible focus ring test in both compact and expanded rail states. And ensure skip link works on first tab press ("Skip to main content" anchors #main).
aisha: For the sidebar affordance, propose a compact mode where only icons show and a persistent narrow rail appears. Hover-to-expand will be opt-in in settings. Avoid hover-only behaviours for keyboard users.
tess: Quick prototype link: https://figma.redwood/designs/left-rail-regroup-v3 (contains annotated a11y notes). Can people review before EOD?
design-bot: [test-run] nav-highlight-priority: flaky on CI (some runs show cluster highlighted incorrectly). Ticket: ENG-4923.
maria: Ok action items: Eli -> route/highlight fixes + tests. Samir -> ARIA/focus audit + focus-ring tests. Aisha -> run 2-option copy poll (Projects vs Apps) in #research and collect responses. Tess -> finalize Figma annotations. I'll schedule a 15-min sync tomorrow 9:30 PT to review fixes. :calendar: 
eli: On it, starting with unit tests now.
samir: Doing the audit this afternoon.
aisha: Poll scheduled. Will share results by morning.
tess: Reviewing prototype comments and adding notes.
